page.overview:
Who is Markus Krankzler?

Markus one of veteran racers in Cars 3. He races for Transberry Juice, having replaced Lee Revkins sometime since the first film. He sports a new number, 6, as opposed to the 63 Lee had. However, as next-generation racers prove to be more able than the veterans, Markus either gets fired or he retires and a next-generation racer named Bubba Wheelhouse Jr. takes his place.
